changes.text: Check in once a day on the front page for Credit: $50, or $100 while you're on a trading streak (you traded yesterday). Miss a day of trading and it drops back to $50.

The check-in card shows today's Credit, what tomorrow's pays if you trade today, and what it drops to if you don't. A new day starts at 00:00 UTC, the same time trade streaks count a new day. Verified accounts only.
